subject: Updated plyr, now having trouble with aaply

messages.author: d67e993806d464c5
messages.subject: Updated plyr, now having trouble with aaply
parts:
Hi! I just upgraded to the the new version of plyr, but now I get the
following error message.


> library(plyr)
> wq=matrix(rnorm(100),nrow=25,ncol=4)
> aaply(wq,1,mean)
Error in .Primitive("[")(dots[[1L]][[1L]], dots[[2L]][[1L]]) :
invalid subscript type 'list'

as a check, I did:

> apply(wq,1,mean)
[1] -0.35112195 -0.06112810 0.13151927 -0.93388925 0.14630600
0.76429558
[7] -0.12750679 -0.34300113 -0.13022006 -0.36649000 -1.20425520
-0.36278765
[13] -0.25900054 0.62621382 0.55070254 -0.24076549 -0.99142581
0.34477118
[19] 0.23085257 0.04791294 -0.07940177 0.26751969 0.48101926
-0.29454674
[25] 0.48826441


It's been happening with every aaply call that I try, but this is the
simplest example I could come up with.

Am I doing something wrong?

Michael Braun
